author: Daniel Rudford
title: Country Club Trust Company n.a. Trims Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

organizations.name: country club trust company n.a. trims position in apple inc.

text:
Country Club Trust Company n.a. cut its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.1% in the third quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 46,422 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,463 shares during the period. Apple comprises approximately 1.2% of Country Club Trust Company n.a.’s portfolio, making the stock its 26th largest position. Country Club Trust Company n.a.’s holdings in Apple were worth $10,479,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
Other institutional investors and hedge funds also recently made changes to their positions in the company. Addenda Capital Inc. raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 91.5% in the second quarter. Addenda Capital Inc. now owns 155,634 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $27,400,000 after buying an additional 74,349 shares during the last quarter. Krueger & Catalano Capital Partners LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 1.7% in the second quarter. Krueger & Catalano Capital Partners LLC now owns 19,295 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,572,000 after buying an additional 325 shares during the last quarter. First National Bank of Omaha raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 2.6% in the second quarter. First National Bank of Omaha now owns 271,113 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $49,481,000 after buying an additional 6,766 shares during the last quarter. Chesley Taft & Associates LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 1.3% in the second quarter. Chesley Taft & Associates LLC now owns 122,335 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $22,645,000 after buying an additional 1,515 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Miller Green Financial Services Inc. ADV purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the second quarter valued at about $879,000. 57.02% of the stock is owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors.
Get Apple alerts: A number of equities research analysts have recently commented on AAPL shares. Bank of America reaffirmed a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, October 9th. UBS Group set a $250.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, October 8th. Citigroup upped their target price on shares of Apple from $230.00 to $265.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, October 8th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $272.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 10th. Finally, Rosenblatt Securities set a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, October 22nd. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have given a hold rating and twenty-two have assigned a buy rating to the company. Apple has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus price target of $195.33.
In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares in the company, valued at $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this link . Corporate insiders own 0.05% of the company’s stock.
Shares of AAPL opened at $154.68 on Wednesday. The company has a current ratio of 1.12, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. Apple Inc. has a twelve month low of $142.00 and a twelve month high of $233.47. The stock has a market cap of $775.41 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 12.99, a P/E/G ratio of 1.52 and a beta of 1.23.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the business posted $2.07 earnings per share. The firm’s revenue for the quarter was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. Equities analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.88 EPS for the current year.
The business also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 14th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 11th will be given a dividend of $0.73 per share. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.89%. Apple’s payout ratio is currently 24.52%.
